answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 28218 Country: United Arab Emirates Title: I heard it is compulsary (wajib) to say "auzubillahiminashshaitanirrajeem" before reading any ayah of the Quraan shareef. i read ayatu kursi after every farz namaz so do i have to say tauz before ayatul kursi too? Question: i heard it is compulsary (wajib) to say "auzubillahiminashshaitanirrajeem" before reading any ayah of the Quraan shareef. i read ayatu kursi after every farz namaz so do i have to say tauz before ayatul kursi too? Answer ID: 28218 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 52/52/M=1432) It is masnoon to recite ta'auz (اعوذ بالله من الشيطان الرجيم) before reciting the holy Quran. Though reciting Ayatul Kursi after fardh salah is not for the purpose of recitation, then also it is better to recite ta'auz. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
